name: lattice-lang
description: Lattice runtime for Node.js - A statically-typed language for structured LLM interactions

scripts.build-release:linux: cargo zigbuild --release --features sql --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && cp ../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/liblattice_node.so npm/linux-x64/index.node
scripts.build-release:all: npm run build-release && npm run build-release:linux
scripts.publish:platforms: npm run publish:darwin-arm64 && npm run publish:linux-x64
scripts.publish:all: npm run prepublish:darwin-arm64 && npm run publish:platforms && npm publish --access public
